    rotation_data: dict,

        rotation_id=rotation_data['rotation_id'],
        schain_nodes_with_schains=schain_nodes_with_schains,

        generation=generation,
        is_owner_contract=is_owner_contract,
        skale_manager_opts=skale_manager_opts
    )
